customer: Quick question — my EV sat in some standing water during last month's storm here in North Carolina. Water got into the cabin a bit. Can I still sell it to Northwind?
agent: Thanks for checking before requesting an offer. Per our Flood-damaged cars article, cars with flood damage or a flood brand on the title count as branded, and we don't buy them (see Salvage and rebuilt titles). Since water got into the cabin, please tell us that when you request an offer.
